name: zuttomae
author: Wyntaee
description: Fall to the floor before the platform at 14% instead of entering the yellow gravity portal. Jump right before reaching the saw in the floor at 15% to also go under the later platform. Stay at the floor until 50%, where you'll need to jump over the hitboxes until 52% while staying under the invisible saw. Continue playing normally after you enter the ship portal at 52%.
